paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a,
heading: Edom Gawtna

paite: "Mihing tapa, Seir tang masuan inla, atung ah thu gen in. Akiang ah,
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai in, Aw Seir tang, ka hon dou hi, na tung ah ka khut ka lik ding a, ka hon hihgawp in mulkimhuaitak in ka hon bawl ding.
Na khopite ka hihse ding a, na kigawp ding; huan TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding."
Na nitna uh gawtna nanungpen a asiat ni ua Israel inkote namsau thilhihtheihna a na lat a, na kinakpih gige ziak in,
kei ka hin bang in, sisan a ding in ka hon bawl ding a, sisan in ahon delh ding; sisan na huat louh ziak in sisan in ahon delh ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
Hichi in Seir tang bel mulkimhuaitak a bawl in ka sugawp ding; atung a mi vialvakte ka tawpsak vek ding hi.
Atangte amah mithahte in ka dimsak ding; na tangte ah, na phaizang leh na lui phaizang kuakte ah namsau a thahte apuk phengphung ding uh.
Ka hon sugawp den ding a, na khopite luah in a-om kei ding; huan kei TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding hi.
TOUPA zaw a-om gige na a, "Hiai nam nihte leh gam nihte kei a ahi ding a, ka tang mai ding uh," na chih ziak in.

Kei ka hin bang in chih, Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, na hehna bang zel leh na huatna ziak a hazatna na suklatdan bang zel in ka hih ding ahi; na tungthu ka ngaihtuah hun chiang in alak uah ka hihlang ding hi.
"Hihgawp in a-omta ua, ka kiang ah piak in a-omta uh," chi a Israel tangte na gensiatna tengteng kei TOUPA'N ka za vek chih na thei ding hi.
Ka tung ah na kam in na kiliansak in ka tung ah thu na tamsak a, ka za vek hi.
Hichi in Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi: Lei pumpi kipahna ding in ka hon sugawp ding hi.
Israelte gouluah asiat ziak a na kipah mah bang in na tung ah ka hih ding; Aw Seir tang leh Edom tengteng, avek in akisegawp ding; huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
